en: Colorized seaside view taken from the water looking toward a beach resort town. In the foreground are dark green ocean waves; in the midground stands a long wooden pier with a white building on top. On the sandy shore behind the pier are beachgoers and beach huts, and further back several large, ornate villa-style buildings with towers and steep roofs line the waterfront. The card has printed captions in German at the bottom margin.
